title: fix (or route around) opencode's silent zero-completion runs
motivation: Moves **T9** (autonomy/origination): the opencode timer's entire purpose is raising loop-authored throughput independent of the Claude quota window (`add-opencode-deepseek-provider`'s stated goal); at 0/7 completion it contributes nothing to `t9_loop_yield_7d` or `t9_autonomy_origination_share` despite consuming a live scheduled slot every hour
